title: Throughput Sculptor: continuous workload fingerprinting and cautious batch parameter annealer
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: We need an automated engine that turns live workload signals into conservative batching + caching configuration changes that reduce per-token cost while respecting latency SLOs. Existing static heuristics either under-optimize (leaving potential savings on the table) or are too aggressive and cause latency regressions during traffic spikes.

Goal: Build a continuous "Throughput Sculptor" subsystem that: (1) profiles request shapes and KV cache locality across customers and routes, (2) synthesizes a set of candidate batching parameter deltas (microbatch size, target latency headroom, burst-safe coalescing window, KV windowing thresholds), (3) simulates those candidates against recent replayed traffic to estimate cost/latency impact, and (4) applies the safest candidate via a staged rollout (shadow, canary, incremental traffic ramp) with automatic rollback triggers and post-apply verification.

Scope & non-goals: Scope covers hosted inference and dedicated pools; private on-prem rollout will be covered by a later integration ticket. We will not change model-level quantization profiles in this ticket. This work focuses on config parameters that the runtime can accept at request-routing time without model rebuilds.

Core components: 
- Workload Fingerprinter: lightweight histogram and fingerprint extraction over inter-arrival time, sequence length distribution, KV cache hit patterns, and request affinity. Runs at route level and per-customer where applicable.
- Candidate Synthesizer: rule-based + small ML heuristic that proposes conservative parameter deltas based on fingerprint clusters. Includes cost/latency estimate model and a minimax safety budget.
- Replay Simulator: deterministic replay of the last 24–72 hours of anonymized traces (sampled) to simulate candidate impact on latency distribution and per-token cost. Produces confidence bands.
- Staged Applier: orchestration for shadow-apply -> canary (1% traffic) -> ramp-up (1% -> 10% -> 50%) using existing rollout APIs in Console. Integrates with runtime feature flags and preserves original configs for rollback.
- Safety & Rollback: set of automatic rollback triggers (P95 latency increase > 10% over baseline, error rate > 0.5%, drops in KV hit-ratio > 8%, or customer-flagged SLA breaches). Manual abort path for SRE.

Success criteria: 
- 5–12% token-cost reduction across experimental routes without breaking latency SLOs (P99 < baseline + 8ms) in initial cohort.
- No more than one automatic rollback per 1000 route-applies in the first month in prod.
- Observability: per-change diff dashboard and a/b metrics in Console (cost delta, latency delta, KV hit delta).

MVP timeline: 6 weeks to alpha on staging, 4 weeks for safe canary expansion, 6–8 weeks to GA for hosted small routes. Dedicated pools will follow in the same release if initial results meet targets.

Open design questions: 
1) Fingerprint retention and privacy: store only aggregated histograms; ensure alignment with privacy and data retention policies.
2) How aggressive should the default minimax safety budget be for new routes with sparse telemetry? Suggest starting at 2% coalescing increase and 5% microbatching bump.
3) Integration with existing batching recommender APIs: will we reuse the current /recommend endpoint or add /sculpt?

Artifacts & links: 
- Design doc (internal): https://redwood.atlassian.com/confluence/display/INF/Throughput+Sculptor+Design 
- Initial simulation notebooks: drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SculptorSim 
- Related GitHub PR (prototype sampler): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4219

Next steps: 
- Complete Fingerprinter proto and add telemetry schema (2 days).
- Implement Candidate Synthesizer rule set + cost estimator (4 days).
- Build Replay Simulator harness and run offline experiments on 3 representative routes (7 days).
- Integrate Staged Applier with rollout API and create automated rollback monitor (5 days).
- Prepare console dashboard surface for change diffs (3 days).
